en: Dependent on a state that is neither a fetter nor a root ... (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of roots ... pe ...
one in the case of resultants ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a bond nor a root ... (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause, five; ... [and so on] ... in the case of resultant, one; ... [and so on] ... in the case of non-disappearance, five.
Dependent on a state that is not a flood and not a root-cause ... dependent on a state that is not a bond and not a root-cause ...
(Abbreviated. In the case of root-cause, five; ... [and so on] ... in the case of resultant, one; ... [and so on] ... in the case of non-disappearance, five.
Dependent on a state that is neither a hindrance nor a root cause. (Abbreviated. In the case of root cause:
nine … pe … in the case of resultant: one … pe … in the case of non-disappearance: nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither attachment nor a root cause. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; ... pe ... in the case of the resultant condition, there is one; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are five.
